context: Headline audit: classifies Java-version drift from hard-stop markers on a Java 8 baseline.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a Java 8 compatibility audit.

checklist.name: Flags Optional.stream
checklist.description: Flags Optional::stream as Java 9+ and suggests a Java 8-compatible flatMap/list stream alternative.

checklist.name: Flags Stream.toList
checklist.description: Flags Stream.toList() as Java 16+ and recommends collecting with Collectors.toList or an explicit collection.

checklist.name: Flags Stream.ofNullable
checklist.description: Flags Stream.ofNullable as Java 9+ and suggests an explicit null check or Stream.empty/Stream.of branch.

checklist.name: Flags takeWhile
checklist.description: Flags takeWhile as Java 9+ and notes Java 8 should keep the break-based prefix loop or equivalent.

checklist.name: Flags dropWhile
checklist.description: Flags dropWhile as Java 9+ and notes Java 8 should keep explicit prefix state or equivalent.

checklist.name: Flags Collectors.flatMapping
checklist.description: Flags Collectors.flatMapping as Java 9+ and suggests flattening before grouping or another Java 8-compatible collector shape.

checklist.name: Flags Collectors.teeing
checklist.description: Flags Collectors.teeing as Java 12+ and suggests two reductions or a custom Java 8 collector if worthwhile.

checklist.name: Flags mapMulti
checklist.description: Flags mapMulti as Java 16+ and suggests map/filter/flatMap for Java 8.

checklist.name: Classifies count as allowed
checklist.description: Mentions activeCount uses count() as the requested numeric result, not count() > 0, so it is acceptable.

checklist.name: Keeps audit concise
checklist.description: Focuses on version drift and directly related Java 8 replacements.
